title: The release gate races the asynchronous post-commit auto-capture: HEAD can move mid-gate
observation: Gate run #5 for v1.12.0 failed source-integrity with 'HEAD moved from 8d6cdeb to fda97ba' after a fully green suite (1046/1046): the post-commit hook's auto-capture from the immediately preceding source commit landed its own 'hunch: capture' commit WHILE the ~25-minute gate was running. This is a new instance of the refresh-treadmill family (fnd_6391b4242f) with a different mechanism: not stale grounding counts, but capture-commit latency overlapping the gate window. Workaround that worked: wait for capture quiescence (clean tree + stable HEAD for ~20s) before starting the gate. Candidate fixes: (a) the gate waits for capture quiescence in preflight, or (b) the gate pins its baseline to gate-start HEAD and tolerates trailing commits that touch only .hunch/ + regenerated grounding docs.
